comparison.objective: Declutch a powerless valve actuator and close the valve manually.
comparison.physical_skill: Hold a declutch lever while turning/regrasping a handwheel until engagement, then continue to a stop.
comparison.success_condition: Clutch engaged and valve within 5 degrees of closed, held for 3 seconds.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared pattern—bimanual stabilization plus rotary state change—but it tests mode engagement and valve closure. The candidate additionally requires recessed hex-key use, a separately locked fine collar, repeated response-based tuning and no-bottoming/rebound validation. No separate spec versions were present; the body supplied the rubric.
